results.question: which category's completed rentals went up the most from 2024 to 2025?

    AND d.completed_on IS NOT NULL

    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM completed_on) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS rentals
  FROM rentals

)

  category,
  rentals_2025 - rentals_2024 AS delta,
  rentals_2025 AS rentals_2025,
  rentals_2024 AS rentals_2024
FROM (
  SELECT category, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN rentals ELSE 0 END) AS rentals_2025,

results.question: of the students who completed a deal in fall 2024, as buyer or seller, what percent also completed one in fall 2025?

  WHERE d.status = 'completed'
